reading_note: The arc describes the revealing-mirror that stands before divine truth: the cyclic process by which every interior state of falsity-from-evil is made manifest to the Lord. The Wheel is the medium of judgment — it reflects the roots of every false principle, above and below, so that no hidden intention, no contrived deceit, no narrow or wide region of the spiritual mind, can remain concealed. Twelve seals (the full circuit of states) and at the center five Men of Radiance (the five discrete degrees of divine truth filling the whole zone) make every motion visible. The wheel functions as the standing chain before the chief guardian — the lawful order which holds the false principles bound by the very fact of their being seen — so that fear seizes them and none can peer beyond the chain of their own fruits. The single arc: from the existence of this mirror, through what is bound and concealed within it, to its function as the great mirror of judgment of all works.
